Notice of Adverse Determination

Member ID: MBR526445914

Service Reviewed: Inpatient admission for COPD exacerbation, DRG 190
Dates of Service: [[ADMIT_DATE]] through [[DISCHARGE_DATE]]
Type of Review: Adverse determination, level of care, inpatient versus observation

Determination

Cascade Mutual has completed a level of care review of the above admission and has issued an adverse determination. Based on the records submitted, the billed inpatient level of care is not supported. The documented clinical condition supported an observation level of care rather than an inpatient stay, and the length of stay exceeded what the documented clinical condition supported.

Criteria Applied

This review was conducted using the payer's MCG-style criteria set. The following guideline codes were reviewed and found not met:

COPD-01: Oxygenation was near baseline and did not require inpatient care.

COPD-03: Blood gas values did not show acute respiratory acidosis.

No other guideline codes were applied in this level of care determination.

Claim Adjustment Information

The claim has been adjusted with the following codes:

CARC CO-50
RARC N130

Appeal Rights

You or your authorized representative may request reconsideration of this level of care determination. Appeals must be submitted in writing and addressed to Utilization Management at the address shown on this notice. Each argument should reference the applicable guideline code, either COPD-01 or COPD-03, and respond to the specific finding stated above for that code. Supporting documentation from the medical record should be attached and clearly labeled.

The written appeal must include a physician attestation line signed by the treating or reviewing physician.

Appeals must be received by [[APPEAL_DEADLINE]]. Appeals received after that date may not be eligible for review.

This determination addresses the level of care billed for the admission described above. The member is not financially liable beyond applicable plan cost sharing where provider liability applies under the participation agreement.

Questions regarding this notice may be directed to the Utilization Management Department using the contact information on the member identification card.

Sincerely,

Medical Director, Utilization Management
Cascade Mutual
